remarks: Just steps from the heart of the village of New Canaan, this beautifully renovated and expanded home offers modern living spaces throughout with exquisite private stone patios and gardens. A gracious covered porch welcomes you, leading into a stunning living room and den adorned with a fireplace, multiple seating areas and walls of windows. The spacious cooks Kitchen integrates seamlessly with the large Family Room and french doors to a private patio. Upstairs, the oversized Primary Suite is abundant with closets and a large marble bathroom, nearby a sitting room/office/nursery with hall bath, additional en-suite bedroom and the laundry. The 3rd floor provides a bedroom with full bath and a flexible space for playroom or office. A side staircase leads to a separate wing offering a two-room suite complete with private bath. Lower Level room perfect for playroom or exercise space. Unrivaled in town location and exceptional craftsmanship defines this stunning residence.
